{{Top|leg}}
'''Keldran''' was an individual who recommended a security team accompany [[Kaya Natari]], a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] researcher, to the corporation's survey of the ruined [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The security team saved Natari when creatures attacked Natari at the site, prompting Natari to record a note in a field journal reminding Natari to thank Keldran for recommending the security.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Dantooine Enclave Restoration}}</ref>
